title: Teaching Language Models to Adapt Answer Granularity to Their Confidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.21211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When precise details are uncertain, a coarser answer can retain useful information without guessing or abstaining. We investigate whether language models can learn this behavior through model-conditioned supervision derived from consistency across sampled responses and recognition of answers at different granularity levels. We evaluate LFM2.5-1.2B, Ministral~3~3B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Gemma~4~31B on temporal and geographic questions and three generalization datasets. In several in-domain settings, fine-tuning improves the balance of correctness and informativeness beyond coarsening base answers to the best fixed level. Across generalization datasets, all four models produce coarser answers more often at low than high base-model confidence. The three smaller models' answers are also preferred over base responses on held-out relations when correctness and granularity are considered jointly. These findings demonstrate learnable confidence-relate

translated_title: 教语言模型根据自身置信度调整答案粒度
translated_abstract: 当精确细节不确定时，更粗粒度的答案可以在不进行猜测或放弃作答的情况下保留有用的信息。我们研究了语言模型能否通过基于模型自身状态的监督学习到这种行为，该监督来源于采样响应之间的一致性以及对不同粒度层级答案的识别。我们在时间类和地理类问题以及三个泛化数据集上评估了LFM2.5-1.2B、Ministral 3 3B、Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma 4 31B四个模型。在若干域内设置中，微调提升了正确性与信息量之间的平衡，其效果超过了将基础答案粗化到最佳固定水平的做法。在泛化数据集上，所有四个模型在基础模型置信度较低时比置信度较高时更频繁地给出更粗粒度的答案。当综合考虑正确性与粒度时，三个较小模型的答案在保留关系上也优于基础模型的响应。这些发现证明了置信度相关的粒度适应行为是可学习的。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于模型自身一致性的监督方法，训练语言模型学会在置信度低时给出更粗粒度但仍保留有用信息的答案，从而在不猜测或拒答的情况下改善正确性与信息量之间的平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes model-conditioned supervision that teaches language models to adapt answer granularity to their confidence, producing coarser yet informative answers when uncertain, thereby improving the balance between correctness and informativeness without guessing or abstaining.
